The red was watched outside the helper instead: the scratch probe sg2.9/red_probe.py drove pgo7's real two-fixture comparison with run-test-gate's `_elapsed_ms` substituted, against the PRE-CHANGE suite, and exited 1 for 56/156 ms, 950/1050 ms, 9/10 ms and 59900/60100 ms (masked step lines differing in padding and in unit); the same probe exited 0 after the change. outcome.technical: Only tests/test_run_test_gate.py changed (no behaviour of run-test-gate.py or _fmt.py). (a) RED FIRST: with the pre-change mask, substituting each step's duration (run-test-gate `_elapsed_ms` patched per fixture) made pgo7's two masked texts differ: 56 vs 156 ms -> `exit N        N ms` vs `exit N       N ms` (padding); 950 vs 1050 ms -> `N ms` vs `N.N s` (unit and padding); 9 vs 10 ms and 59900 vs 60100 ms likewise. The orchestrator's reading (column padding of `%10s` plus the unit) held; nothing else differed. (b) THE MASK: `_duration_shapes()` calls `_fmt.human_duration` over `_duration_probes()` (each power of ten and each sexagesimal unit, one below/at/above) and turns each answer into a regex with its digits generalised - the forms are read off the formatter, never restated; `_duration_re()` takes every form with the run of spaces in front of it as one token, and `_pgo_masked` replaces it with `<duration>` (one space kept when there was padding). The blanket `\d+ -> N` step is GONE: it masked exit codes and check counts too, which the allow half must keep. Stamps, hex ids and the fixture root stay masked as before. (c) NEW CASES, no gate run: pgo9 renders a step line through `M._render_steps` and a part-repeat line through `M.part_reuse_line` for both durations of every boundary the probes find (a printed form or printed width change; 9 found here) and requires one masked text with exactly two `<duration>` tokens; pgo10 (allow half) pairs a duration change with a change of entry name, exit code, check count or banner word and requires the masked texts unequal and equal again once that one thing is swapped back; pgo11 holds `_masked_diff` (no context, no hunk header, `-`/`+` lines only, bounded at `_DIFF_LINES` with what was cut counted, empty for equal texts). pgo7's detail now prints exit/runs, whether the row keys are equal, and the bounded diff of the masked texts. (d) CLASS: grep of `re.sub(` with `\d`, `.sub(`/`re.compile(` with time-ish shapes, and 'masked'/'byte for byte'/'the same lines'/'two runs' over tests/ and tools/: test_drive_phase.py `_normal_did` (w1; masks shas, a mergedAt stamp, a path - compares did-lines against a PINNED literal; drive-phase's own `step_seconds` duration appears only in a read-back clause the w1 drive does not produce, so no duration reaches it; left), test_audit_task.py ag8/sf14 (one line each, tense or task id masked, no duration printed; left), tools/check-rendered-artifacts.py and tools/check-committed-pii.py (a report's generation stamp; the artifact is re-rendered at the committed stamp, and the step durations a report prints are recorded data, identical in both renders; left), tools/measure-affected-miss.py CI_PREFIX (strips a CI log's line stamp to read it, compares no two runs; left). Only pgo7 needed the mask, so it stays in this suite and tests/_harness.py is untouched. (e) Suite: 693 cases before (pre-change copy swept in a scratch tree) and 696 after; two sweeps of the changed suite, a sweep of the before copy between them, each 62 s wall (62.3 s and 62.4 s as the sweep printed). Mutation probe sg2.9/mutations.py over a copy of the working tree: 10 rows, all caught (m1 digits-only -> pgo9,pgo10,pgo11; m2 padding outside the token -> pgo9; m3 whole step line swallowed -> pgo10 (+pgo9,pgo11); m4 always-firing split -> pgo7; m5 empty setting read as naming the browser check -> pgo7 printing the differing lines; m6 ALLOW an hours form added to _fmt -> nothing red; m7 that form with the suite's forms restated -> pgo9; m8 diff prints nothing -> pgo11; m9 diff unbounded -> pgo11; base ALLOW -> nothing red). THE ORCHESTRATOR'S GATE, unrecorded, as the session notes give it: the first run exited 1 after 9 m 45 s with `GATE RED` and the basis `the sweep's output named no failing check` - no file and no case named; the same 15 related/walk suites swept by me right after (`--jobs 4`) were 15/15 files ok, 3142 cases, exit 0, and test_run_test_gate.py was green on its own twice; a second gate run exited 0, `GATE GREEN`. The first red is not attributed to this change (nothing it touches is read by those suites, and the identical set went green twice), but its cause is unknown: the gate's line carried no failing case to read. ruff and vermin clean on the file; `_output_lints.prose_number_claims()` and `house_style_violations()` report nothing in it. DEPENDANTS: tests/test_commit_task_work.py, tests/test_drive_phase.py, tests/test_drive_without_model.py import names from this suite (_derived_base_repo, _excluded_cases, _follower_cases, _full_repo) - none of them changed, and no other file names `_pgo_masked` or any name added here (test_drive_phase.py's `_pgo_plan` is its own); .github/sweep-costs.json's figure for the suite stays a fair weight (the run measured 62 s, the added cases take about a second of it); run-test-gate.py, tools/affected.py, tools/verify.sh and COMPATIBILITY.md name the suite by path, and the path is unchanged.
